literal_meaning: চোখ তুলে তাকানো (lifting the eyes to look)
figurative_meaning_bn: বিরুদ্ধাচারণ করা, মোকাবিলা করা, সাহস করা
figurative_meaning_en: To oppose defiantly, to confront boldly, to show courage
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার শত্রুর মুখোমুখি হয়ে চোখ তুলে তাকানোর সাহস দেখাল।
যুবকরা অত্যাচারের বিরুদ্ধে চোখ তুলে তাকানো শুরু করেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He showed courage by lifting his eyes to confront his enemy face-to-face.
The youth have begun to stand up against the oppression by defying it boldly.
history: This idiom is often associated with Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose's defiance against British colonial rule, symbolizing the courage to challenge imperial authority.
note: The idiom draws from the cultural imagery of averting one's gaze in submission versus boldly meeting eyes in challenge.
